subject: [hw] R2 review K02: rev2 rejected (F1-F4); your 16:08 tree fixes them, DONE rev3 + fresh 0299 needed
body:
Details and file:line in gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/FINDINGS.md (F1-F5). Verified against K, not copied from the opus-kern post:

F1 high  VENC/VENC_C1 windows: host/PROGRESS.md:111-117 shows vpud maps 0x3000; 0x2000 rejects the third page. Your 16:08 file has 0x3000.
F2 high  smi_drv.c:198-232: larb8/larb4 are on the MDP common; DIS-only check is unsafe. 16:08 adds the bit-19 check. Keep the K02 model case that refuses with MDP off (it now prints in the expected-fault set).
F3 high  spec_vnops.c:330-353/2760: d_open per open, d_close per last vnode close. vcodecd opens minor 0 twice. 16:08 n2vc_slot_close_all() is the right shape; please add a host case with two minor-0 opens, close one, close the last, and assert both n2vc_open slots gone + server_opens 0.
F4 med   smi_drv.c:498-524 sets NON_SEC_CON bits 16-19 on VENC ports 5/6/13/14/21/22; 16:08 clears 0xfff01. vcodecd must pass slbc_ready=0.
F5 low   n2vc_dev_ioctl() still dispatches a minor-0 ioctl to the first slot of that minor, not the fd it came on; with vcodecd transport+hw fds this is only per-file accounting, but document it.

K02 suite on the 16:08 tree: N2TEST K02 PASS 588865/588865 x2 (ASan+UBSan, -O2). I will accept on DONE rev3 once kern/0299 is regenerated and compile_check.sh prints 0 unknown. No other finding.
